outputs: Generated answers to Theory of Mind questions

changes_made.explanation: Added missing tasks (perception inference and perception-to-belief inference) and original source datasets (ToMi, FANToM) that are foundational to this work. Added more specific output descriptions.
Normalized capitalization for metrics and removed duplicate 'set:ALL score' while keeping standard metric names.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper; LLMs were used only as models being evaluated, not as evaluators.
The paper mentions manual annotation for dataset creation but no human evaluation of the generated outputs was conducted.

overall_notes: The paper is primarily about evaluating LLMs' theory of mind capabilities, focusing on perception inference and perception-to-belief inference tasks. The main contributions are the creation of perception-augmented datasets and the PercepToM framework. Evaluation is automated using accuracy metrics without human evaluation or LLM-as-judge approaches. The extraction was mostly accurate but missed some foundational datasets and tasks.
